notes: These are templates, NOT approved IFLS expenditure formulas. Check every variable, reference period, and household size definition against IFLS3 and IFLS5 codebooks. Construct month-equivalent nominal Rupiah values without double-counting and include own production when appropriate.

ifls3.notes: Weekly food; include purchases and own production only after verifying fields.

extra_ks0_items: IMPORTANT: KS0 aggregates and other expenditure items may be needed. This builder excludes KS0 until explicitly mapped and approved. Do not call resulting PCE complete if components are omitted.
poverty_line_notes: Required columns: wave,hhid,monthly_poverty_line. Build from documented BPS official thresholds matched to actual interview year and geography; no price levels are invented.
